title: A big run in a batch job
story: For the real design round you want 64 sequences for inputs/{{target}}.pdb at temperature 0.1, with seed 37 so the run can be repeated. Write mpnn.sh, a job named mpnn with 1 GPU, 16 GB and 1 hour, that does this into outputs, submit it and wait for it to finish.

tasks.text: Let it make 64 sequences with seed 37

hints: Inside the script, after the #SBATCH lines: `module load anaconda`, `conda activate proteinmpnn`, then the ProteinMPNN line with `--num_seq_per_target 64 --sampling_temp 0.1 --seed 37`.

solution.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=mpnn
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00
#SBATCH --output=mpnn-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn
python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py --pdb_path inputs/{{target}}.pdb --out_folder outputs --num_seq_per_target 64 --sampling_temp 0.1 --seed 37
